items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: No, I never worked with Muggsy.

ctx.x: I say, hurry up time come forme to get out of this. I told Spain, I said, man don't you send me out -- beg me to go play at nobody like that.

That's great. What we've been doing is sort of talk about some of the instruments that you've enjoyed working with and some of the players, let's continue it if it's all right with you. What were the trumpet players that you enjoyed playing with the most? What trumpet player?
